name: bdd-skills
description: 繁體中文 BDD 情境撰寫與本機實測技能

interface.shortDescription: 撰寫 BDD 情境並執行本機驗證
interface.longDescription: 將功能異動整理成繁體中文 Gherkin 情境，執行本機驗證並產出報告。
interface.defaultPrompt: Use bdd-local-test to write Traditional Chinese BDD scenarios and verify them locally. Review the final candidate diff before testing. Assign subagents to verify the core changes and their prerequisites first, then the remaining acceptance criteria for the specified issue. If issue updates are authorized and related tests remain, review the issue results first. Have a dedicated subagent update the issue and read it back before assigning the remaining tests. Once all BDD checks pass, compare the tested and delivery revisions and confirm Code Review coverage. Reuse the review for the same diff. Review new or uncovered changes and retest based on their impact. Obtain PR or release approval under the project rules. After the results report and any applicable consistency review pass, have an authorized subagent update the issue, upload the required evidence, and read back the update and attachments. Honor report-only and no-update requests. Change issue status only with separate authorization.
